Subject: Estimate and follow-up: Redwood inference for ACME IoT

Hi Dana —

Really appreciated the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Goal: reduce inference cost for ACME's device telemetry pipeline while hitting sub-200ms tail latency for 512-token prompts.
- Primary constraint: deployable in your VPC and able to integrate with existing ingestion pipelines.
- Success metrics: 30–40% token cost reduction, predictable 99th pctl latency at scale.

I attached an initial estimate and two proposed deployment patterns (hosted + private option) so you can see the cost/latency tradeoffs. The key pieces in the PDF: pricing tiers, recommended GPU families, and an optional SRE-managed onboarding block for the first 3 months.

Attachment: [redwood_estimate_ACME_20260316.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) Confirm which deployment path you want us to price (hosted vs private).
2) Schedule a 30-min walkthrough so our solutions engineer (Laura) can run through the estimate line-by-line and answer integration questions.
3) If procurement needs anything (SOC 2 copy, network architecture diagram), I can scope that immediately.

Can you confirm you received the estimate and whether a walkthrough this or next week would be helpful? Happy to send a calendar invite — here are my windows: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT, Thu 2–4 PT.

Thanks — I’ll stand by.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
